name: search_documents
description: Search the published report, supplements, summaries, glossaries, public decisions and site text. Pass several phrasings at once. Returns passage ids with a snippet; cite a passage as [[id]].

name: read_passages
description: Full text of passages by id (from search_documents). Read before stating detail. Max 4 ids per call.

name: search_numbers
description: Search the committed pipeline CSVs (report numbers, figure map, cluster table, pipeline manifest). Every number you state must come from a row returned here; cite it as [[id]].

name: cluster_summary
description: Counts and well lists for each cluster in the current partition, from outputs/02_cluster_stats.csv. Cite as [[f:outputs/02_cluster_stats.csv]].

name: find_reference
description: Look up a literature reference (author, year, title). Returns the full citation and where it is published. The texts themselves are not available. Cite as [[id]].
